pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark-pigmented regions. Edges show moderate angularity with distinct vertices, though pixel gradients are softened by motion blur. Relative spatial area is highest on the mid-flank, with patches becoming progressively smaller and more densely clustered toward the anterior neck region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-colored interstitial pathways forming an interconnected topological graph. Junction nodes predominantly feature tri-radial intersections. Pixel thickness is generally consistent across the flank, with slight narrowing observed at the transition to the neck.
